intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A courtier stops to tell Kaedra about nothing in particular. While he talks, she refastens the loose clasp on his cloak.

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: He does not notice. He bows and leaves, securely fastened.

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “That is the fourth time. He believes he is very good at clasps.”

intro.speaker: KAEDRA
intro.text: “If I tell him, it becomes an incident. Incidents have forms.”

options.labelText: “I saw that, though. Very smooth. He has no idea.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Noted. I will have to keep an eye on you.”

options.labelText: “Next time, do it where he can see. You should get some credit.”

branch.speaker: KAEDRA
branch.text: “Then he would know. And he would stop coming over to talk about nothing.”
